description: MainActivity class for an Android Tic Tac Toe application. This file manages UI interactions, rendering, state persistence, and delegates game logic to the GameLogic class. It handles binding views, user interactions, game state restoration, and UI updates based on game progress.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity that handles the Tic Tac Toe game UI, user interactions, and state management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, restores saved state, and sets up click listeners.

methods.name: restoreFromBundle
methods.description: Restores game state from a saved bundle, reconstructing the game board and current player.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Serializes current game state into a bundle for persistence across configuration changes.

methods.name: wireCellClicks
methods.description: Sets click listeners for each cell in the 3x3 grid.

methods.name: onCellClicked
methods.description: Handles user taps on a cell, updates game state via GameLogic, and refreshes UI.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to the initial state, clearing the board and UI.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI components to reflect current game state, including board, turn indicator, and result messages.

methods.name: disableBoard
methods.description: Disables user interactions on the game grid after game ends.
